<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ELEMENT ext (#PCDATA)>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY ref "&base; Expanded">
  <?pi-target processing instruction data here?>
  <!-- Comment inside DOCTYPE internal subset -->
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns1" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns2">
  <!-- Top level comment before element -->
  <?custom-pi data="test"?>
  <child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text containing <tags> and &ref; references inside.
    ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&ref;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "Internal Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; with extension">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY img SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY paramEnt 'Parameter Value'>">
  %param;
  <!-- Comment block 1 -->
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="urn:catalog:root" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment block 2 -->
  <?catalog-meta author="test"?>
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with special characters: <foo> &bar; "baz"
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&ent2;</item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY beta "α Beta">
  <!ENTITY gamma "β Gamma">
  <?db-conf version="2.0"?>
  <!-- DTD-level comment explaining entities -->
]>
<database xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/db" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <?xi:include href="fallback.xml"?>
  <!-- Comment right before root's children -->
  <record>
    <![CDATA[
      <record>Nested pseudo-xml inside cdata γ</record>
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>γ</record>
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file*)>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY textEnt "Standard Entity Text">
  <!ENTITY complexEnt "&textEnt; More Text">
  <?archive-info status="active"?>
  <!-- Comment detailing archive constraints -->
]>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:meta="http://example.org/metadata">
  <!-- Comment inside archive root -->
  <meta:properties>
    <?meta-action refresh="true"?>
  </meta:properties>
  <file>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Comment inside CDATA -->
      <?pi-inside-cdata test?>
      &complexEnt;
    ]]>
  </file>
  <file>&complexEnt;</file>
</archive>
```

]>

  <?ns-process mode="strict"?>
  <section ns:id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw content stream with entities like &entC; and markup <test/>.
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section>&entC;</section>
</document>
